diagnosis: The dependency get_billing_client caches a singleton httpx.AsyncClient instance on self._client configured with the X-Authenticated-Tenant header from the initial request. Subsequent requests across different tenants reuse the existing client instance and its stale tenant header, returning credit cards and payment methods belonging to the first tenant.
exploit_request:
GET /gateway/billing/payment-methods HTTP/1.1
Host: api.platform-billing.com
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_2_token>
X-Tenant-ID: tenant_002
